purpose: Force Unit Banks to be designed around exact Assessment Plan I-can statements rather than filling section quotas first and attaching I-can labels afterward.

authority_model.atomic_design_unit: Exact I-can statement from the original Unit Assessment Plan.
authority_model.grouping: Learning Targets group related I-cans; Mastery Goals organize/report accumulated evidence across I-cans.
authority_model.inventory_role: Section/destination counts are containers and reconciliation totals only. They do not determine how many questions an I-can deserves.

pre_authoring_i_can_evidence_plan.rule: Complete and inspect the full I-can evidence plan before authoring multi-item inventories. Repair zero-coverage, unsupported overconcentration, or template clustering at this stage.
pre_authoring_i_can_evidence_plan.question_design_map: After the exact I-can evidence plan, instantiate unitN_question_design_map.json using contracts/question_design_map_contract.json before prompt authoring.

item_mapping.rule: Every canonical item has exactly one primary I-can for routing/coverage. Synthesis items may list additional supporting I-cans, but supporting tags do not replace direct primary evidence coverage.
item_mapping.wtc_exception: WTC still carries one exact content i_can_id/i_can statement, but it may resolve outside the current Unit. Mark coverage_role=wtc_frq_practice. Do not count WTC toward current-Unit I-can coverage.

coverage_floors.notes: Each I-can receives at least one complete canonical Example/YTI pair in its section. With the normal 3 I-cans and maximum 4 pairs, the extra pair is assigned intentionally to the I-can needing additional modeling, representation, or transfer support.
coverage_floors.practice_sets: Each of Practice Set 1, Practice Set 2, Practice Set 3, and Extra Practice includes at least one primary-mapped item for every I-can in the section. Beyond that floor, weighting may be unequal when the evidence job justifies it.
coverage_floors.cyu: Each I-can appears at least once across the section CYU inventory.
coverage_floors.warm_ups: Each I-can appears at least once across Warm-Up 1/2/3 combined; retrieval weighting may vary intentionally.
coverage_floors.exit_tickets: Exit Tickets A, B, and C are parallel section evidence forms. Each form directly samples every exact I-can in the section at least once; the remaining item(s) may emphasize a high-leverage or synthesis job.
coverage_floors.summative: Every Summative form V1-V6 directly samples every exact Unit I-can at least once as a primary I-can. Remaining items are intentionally weighted toward high-leverage, compound, representational, or Mastery-Goal evidence.
coverage_floors.wtc: WTC is coverage-exempt for the current Unit. It is a multi-part FRQ-decomposition routine and may map its content i_can_id to any exact course I-can, including another Unit. That source/content I-can is provenance/metadata only and does not satisfy any current-Unit destination floor.
coverage_floors.tarsia_blooket: Use only where suitable. Record supported I-cans; these exports do not substitute for the canonical coverage floors above.

distribution_rule.overconcentration_rule: Large differences among I-can totals are allowed only when the evidence plan explains why the learning/evidence job needs more independent representations, misconceptions, calculations, or transfer opportunities.
distribution_rule.anti_quota: Do not derive I-can counts by arithmetic symmetry (for example 24 questions / 3 I-cans = 8/8/8). Plan the evidence needs of each I-can first; only then reconcile totals. Equal counts are acceptable only when independently justified by the evidence plan.
distribution_rule.anti_template_across_sections: Do not reuse one fixed P1/P2/P3/Extra allocation pattern across unrelated sections. If the same four-container I-can split signature repeats across three or more sections, the finalizer treats it as quota-template behavior unless the evidence plans independently justify it.

required_machine_handoff.rule: This is a required first-class Bank artifact, not an optional summary.

hard_failures: Any exact I-can from the requested Unit is missing from unit{U}_i_can_map.csv.
Any canonical item lacks a primary i_can_id.
Any I-can lacks a complete Notes Example/YTI pair.
Any Practice Set 1/2/3/Extra omits an I-can from its section.
CYU or combined Warm-Ups omit an I-can from the section.
Any Exit Ticket form A/B/C omits an I-can from the section.
Any Summative form V1-V6 omits an exact Unit I-can.
The same full four-container Practice allocation signature is reused across three or more sections as a fixed template without evidence-specific justification.
A representation-explicit I-can is assessed only through prose descriptions and lacks actual student-facing representation evidence.
A Summative form directly samples a representation-explicit I-can without the actual representation needed by that evidence job.
Any WTC is used to satisfy a current-Unit I-can coverage floor or is treated as current-Unit evidence merely because it appears inside that Unit Bank.
review_flags: Strong I-can count imbalance with no evidence-plan rationale.
Every Practice destination in a section uses the same equal I-can split (for example 8/8/8) without clearly distinct evidence-plan reasons; this suggests quota-first allocation at the I-can level.
One representation/question shell dominates an I-can despite source-supported alternatives.
A higher-DOK label is created by an explanation suffix rather than the I-can evidence job.
A repeated section-allocation pattern suggests one generic weighting template was applied after the I-can plan.
An I-can map names a representation as preferred/required but the canonical items avoid it after the answer-neutrality rule.
A WTC uses cross-Unit/unfamiliar content but requires execution of an untaught procedure instead of accessible FRQ breakdown/representation/planning work.

representation_fidelity.hard_rule: If an exact I-can explicitly names or requires a representation (diagram, graph, table, vector/arrow model, force model, ray, field, circuit, sketch/draw, or equivalent), direct evidence must use an actual student-facing representation rather than prose describing one.
representation_fidelity.instructional_floor: At least one direct instructional item for that I-can must use the required representation, and representation-dependent Notes/Practice/Exit evidence should recur naturally where appropriate.
representation_fidelity.summative_floor: Every Summative form V1-V6 must include actual representation evidence for a representation-explicit I-can when that I-can is directly sampled on the form.
representation_fidelity.answer_neutrality: Required representations remain subject to the student figure answer-neutrality contract; remove answer-bearing labels rather than removing the representation.
